files.description: EHI Export documentation PDF (8 pages). Contains folder organization spec and data dictionary with 44 data classes and ~1,100 column headings. Covers export format (CSV/JSON/XML), folder structure, and complete listing of exported data categories and their fields.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that extracts the data dictionary from the PDF into queryable JSON. Uses pdftotext and a known-name-matching approach to parse all 44 data classes.

Extracted data dictionary in queryable JSON format. Contains 43 of 44 data classes (HM Rules columns merged into Immunizations due to PDF layout) with 1,101 total column names. Includes parse failure accounting.
Documentation for the enrichment extraction process: run commands, input/output files, and known parsing limitations.
